citeinfo.title: Louisiana coastal wetlands Google Earth KMZ: CRMS salinity stations, USGS NWIS sites, CWPPRA basins and persistent land change 1932 to 2016

descript.abstract: Google Earth KMZ (1.33 MB, 35 entries: doc.kml plus 34 images) for southeast Louisiana. It holds 138 point placemarks (33 analysed CRMS hydro stations in four group folders, each with an HTML balloon of salinity statistics and trends and a small salinity chart, and 105 active USGS NWIS sites with their parameters and a link to the USGS page), 10 CWPPRA basin polygons with persistent land loss and gain totals for 1932 to 2016 in their balloons, a ground overlay of USGS SIM 3381 persistent land change for the three study basins (about 90 m display cells, off by default), and a gx:Tour (22 FlyTo steps) through Lake Maurepas and the basin key sites. The KMZ passes XSD validation against OGC KML 2.2 with the Google gx 2.2 extension (outputs/tables/kml_validation_report.txt).
descript.purpose: Portfolio product that packages the CRMS station analysis, the basin land change summary and the USGS monitoring network for viewing in Google Earth, QGIS or ArcGIS Pro (KML To Layer).
descript.supplinf: Independent analysis of public data by Anamika Dristi, Ph.D. Code is MIT licensed. Google Earth Pro, Google Earth Web and ArcGIS Pro were not run; the KMZ was checked only with a schema parser and structure checks. CRMS placemark positions come from the rounded lat and lon columns of crms_station_summary.csv (0.01 degree; up to 641 m from the station positions in data/crms_stations_selected.geojson). Placemark icons are loaded from maps.google.com when the file is opened. How to open and use it: docs/GOOGLE_EARTH_GUIDE.md.

timeperd.current: ground condition (land change 1932 to 2016; CRMS statistics 2006 to 2025; NWIS active site list as downloaded 2026-10-23)

idinfo.useconst: None, beyond citing the author and the data sources (CPRA CRMS and CIMS; USGS). The station statistics describe the published CRMS 'adjusted' record as downloaded on 2026-10-23 and are not an official CPRA product. CRMS data are updated weekly, so later downloads will change the most recent months. Not for regulatory or engineering decisions. USGS states that the SIM 3381 persistent change layer is not meant for rate calculations.
idinfo.datacred: CPRA CRMS and CIMS; Couvillion, B.R. and others (2017) USGS SIM 3381; U.S. Geological Survey NWIS.
idinfo.native: Python 3.11 or newer with simplekml, rasterio, geopandas, matplotlib and lxml on macOS.

attracc.attraccr: CRMS balloon values come from crms_station_summary.csv (see that record for its accuracy notes). Basin land loss and gain totals are cell counts of the full 15 m SIM 3381 raster by basin (225 square meters per cell); the coastwide net of -4,654 square km is close to the -4,833 square km published in SIM 3381, the gap being expected because the layer holds persistent change only and 56 square km of loss falls outside the basin polygons. The ground overlay was resampled by nearest neighbour to about 90 m and shows four color classes only. NWIS site attributes are as reported by the USGS site service and were not analysed.

dataqual.logic: doc.kml parsed by lxml and valid against the OGC KML 2.2 and Google gx 2.2 XSDs; 138 point placemarks, none outside the study box; 10 basin polygon parts; 34 local image references (33 balloon charts and the overlay), none missing; 1 gx:Tour with 22 gx:FlyTo steps and 38 balloon updates whose targets all exist (outputs/tables/kml_validation_report.txt, scripts/08_validate_kml.py).
dataqual.complete: Shows the 33 analysed CRMS stations only (not the full CRMS network), the 105 active NWIS sites with instantaneous values in the box -91.30, 28.90 to -89.60, 30.60, all 10 CWPPRA coastal basins (simplified at 150 m), and the land change overlay for the bounding box of the Pontchartrain, Barataria and Terrebonne basins only. The last SIM 3381 class (2014 to 2015 new water area) is change not yet confirmed as persistent.

horizpa.horizpar: Not assessed. CRMS placemarks are rounded to 0.01 degree (up to 641 m, median 451 m, from the CIMS station positions). NWIS positions are the USGS decimal latitude and longitude. Basin outlines are simplified at 150 m. The overlay is about 90 m per cell after reprojection from the 15 m UTM raster to WGS 84, so small features are under-drawn.

procstep.procdesc: Download (scripts/01_download_data.py): public keyless files fetched from CIMS, ScienceBase and USGS Water Services into the raw data folder (not committed).

Daily means (scripts/02_build_crms_daily.py, 02_daily.awk): the 15 GB hourly CSV streamed from the zip and reduced to one row per station and day: mean adjusted salinity (ppt), adjusted water temperature, adjusted water elevation to datum (ft NAVD88), the number of hourly values and the geoid model. Only surface-water hydro stations (IDs ending -H01, -H02) kept; a daily mean needs at least 12 hourly values. Output: data/crms_selected_daily.csv.gz (selected stations).

Station selection (scripts/03_select_stations.py): CRMS hydro station points (STATION_ID matching CRMSdddd-Hdd) projected to WGS 84 and joined to CWPPRA basins; vegetation type and parish joined from CRMS Sites. Lake Maurepas group = every station within 22 km of 30.255 N, 90.515 W with at least 8 years of record (21 stations). For each of the Pontchartrain, Barataria and Terrebonne basins, 4 key sites outside the Maurepas group picked evenly along latitude from stations with at least 3,650 days of daily salinity and data in 2025. Output: data/crms_stations_selected.csv; outputs/tables/crms_hydro_station_inventory.csv.

Trends and summary (scripts/04_salinity_trends.py): daily values through 2025-12-31 averaged to monthly means (a month needs 15 valid days). Seasonal Mann-Kendall test with seasonal Sen slope (pymannkendall.seasonal_test, period 12) on the full record and on 2013 to 2025; water-level trend only on the longest run of days on one geoid model (GEOID12B from 2013-10-01 at every station). Benjamini-Hochberg false discovery rate q across the 33 stations. Daily salinity percentiles, exceedance shares and the seasonal cycle (mean of monthly means by calendar month) computed per station. Table written with 4 significant digits (pandas float_format %.4g). Output: outputs/tables/crms_station_summary.csv; outputs/tables/crms_monthly_climatology.csv; outputs/tables/crms_group_trend_summary.csv.

GeoJSON export (scripts/06_maps.py): the selected station table converted to WGS 84 points from its lat and lon columns and written with the GDAL GeoJSON driver. Output: data/crms_stations_selected.geojson.

NWIS sites (scripts/03_select_stations.py): active USGS surface-water sites with instantaneous values in the study box parsed from the RDB series catalog, tagged by reported parameters and joined to basins. Output: data/nwis_sites_study_area.csv; data/nwis_sites_study_area.geojson.

Land change by basin and overlay (scripts/05_land_loss_by_basin.py): the SIM 3381 raster (1 to 19 land lost in a mapping interval, 20 to 38 land gained, 0 no persistent change) read in strips, basin polygons rasterized on the same 15 m grid and cells counted by basin and class. For the overlay, the bounding box of the three study basins read at 1/6 resolution with nearest resampling, reprojected to EPSG:4326 and colored: classes 1 to 2 dark red, 3 to 7 red, 8 to 19 orange, 20 to 38 green, others transparent. Output: outputs/tables/land_change_by_basin.csv; outputs/tables/land_loss_by_basin_period.csv; landchange_overlay.png (inside the KMZ).

KMZ build (scripts/07_build_kmz.py, simplekml): styled CRMS placemarks with HTML balloons and charts, NWIS placemarks, basin polygons with land change balloons, the ground overlay and a gx:Tour, packed into one KMZ. Output: outputs/kmz/louisiana_coastal_wetlands.kmz.

Validation (scripts/08_validate_kml.py): lxml parse, XSD validation against OGC KML 2.2 plus the Google gx 2.2 extension, image, extent and tour target checks. Output: outputs/tables/kml_validation_report.txt.
FGDC CSDGM metadata written from the README, the scripts, the validation report and direct inspection of doc.kml with lxml (placemark counts, coordinate extent, overlay LatLonBox).
